title: DREAMS OF TELEVISION // 2026 SUPER BOWL PROPHECY
narrative: The tiny bent woods witch rocks on the weirwood stump, weeping into her rags. 'I gorged on grief at Summerhall,' she wails. 'I dreamt of a shadow with a burning heart... and I dreamt of a great metallic box with glowing liquid crystals! Men in shiny helmets ran across painted grass chasing a pigskin egg while three billion people watched thirty-second adverts for carbonated sugar water! And the Kansas City Chiefs scored in double overtime!'
resolvesPlotHole: The Woods Witch Has Visions of the 21st Century
introducesPlotHole: The Woods Witch 2026 Super Bowl Broadcast

options.text: Deliver the television prophecy to Lady Stoneheart's hollow hill.
Warn the Blackfish before he places bets on the Riverrun sports book.
Connect the psychic feed directly to George's 1987 WordStar PC.
